mapper.update:
/* 대국민포털_업무코드기본 수정 (TaskCdMapper.updateTaskCd) */ UPDATE kids_own.TB_PP_M_TASK_CD SET task_cd_nm = coalesce(#{taskCdNm}, task_cd_nm) ,up_task_cd = coalesce(#{upTaskCd}, up_task_cd) ,task_cd_vl = coalesce(#{taskCdVl}, task_cd_vl) ,task_cd_expln = coalesce(#{taskCdExpln}, task_cd_expln) ,use_yn = coalesce(#{useYn}, use_yn) ,mdfr_id = coalesce(#{mdfrId}, mdfr_id) ,mdfcn_dt = now()
WHERE 1=1 AND task_cd = #{taskCd}
mapper.select: /* 업무코드로부터 업무별 업로드된 파일의 첨부파일ID를 가져오기(TaskCdMapper.getFileIdFromTaskCd) */ SELECT ft.atch_file_id FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm ft INNER JOIN ( SELECT tc.task_cd , tc.task_cd_nm , f.atch_file_id FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_task_cd tc INNER JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_file f ON tc.up_task_cd = f.file_type_cd AND tc.task_cd = f.file_knd_cd WHERE tc.up_task_cd in('DUR', 'GNL') AND tc.task_cd = #{taskCd} ORDER BY f.file_sn DESC LIMIT 1 ) tf ON ft.atch_file_id = tf.atch_file_id
